plan_item: 77.44.7.A — Inspector foundation: responsive typography lifecycle across PARTIAL types
finding: The all-type responsive Inspector lifecycle already covered dimensions, spacing, position, backgrounds, and all ten interaction-state fields, but the standard typography property family did not have a single cross-type browser path through typed controls, Canvas, draft persistence, and public rendering.
change: Added tests/browser/editor-inspector-typography-partial-types.test.js. It exercises all 14 registered responsive typography fields against each of the 44 editable PARTIAL element types, without changing runtime source.
coverage: 44 PARTIAL types × 14 fields: fontFamily, fontSize, fontWeight, fontStyle, lineHeight, letterSpacing, textAlign, textTransform, textDecoration, textWrap, overflowWrap, wordSpacing, textIndent, and textShadow. The test asserts Registry command/key routing, typed select/dimension/number controls, Canvas computed CSS, exact desktop Page Model draft values, Save remains unpublished, Editor reload restores every value, explicit Publish copies the draft, and public computed CSS matches the Canvas for every type.

corrected_fixture_attempts: Default sandbox denied the fixture's loopback HTTP listener (listen EPERM); reran with the permitted network-enabled execution profile, without changing the fixture.
Chromium resolves unitless line-height to computed pixels; corrected the computed-style expectation from 1.7 to 40.8px. The final full matrix passed.
